report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with 63-94ms durations; traces show healthy redis, payment, and postgres spans with pool size 1 and idle 1. Metrics show zero 502s and p95 checkout ~98ms. No fault is established by current evidence; the alert reflects normal latency. Operator hypothesis of a fault is contradicted by healthy telemetry, so hand off rather than assert a bounded cause.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency SLO/threshold for /v1/checkout to determine whether 63-94ms is anomalous
Sustained time-series of checkout latency and error rates over a longer window to detect degradation
Dependency-level latency metrics (redis, payment, postgres) to rule out downstream-latency causes
Connection pool saturation metrics over time to rule out db-pool-exhaustion
